title: Security researchers used Claude to help them hack into OpenAI
raw_excerpt: A team of three independent security researchers at Hacktron says it took less than 72 hours for them to hack into OpenAI employee accounts using Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.8 and 5, The Wall Street Journal reports. They were able to access OpenAI's GitHub repository, called "Monorepo," which reportedly contains "OpenAI's algorithmic secrets," according to The Wall Street Journal 's sources. They stopped short of accessing internal code in Monorepo themselves, but sent a pull request from an employee's Codex account to prove they gained access. They were able to get in through Discourse, the third-party service that hosts OpenAI's community f … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 据《华尔街日报》报道，三名独立安全研究员组成的 Hacktron 团队，利用 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 4.8 与 5，在不到 72 小时内攻入 OpenAI 员工账户，访问到其名为 Monorepo 的 GitHub 仓库（据称含算法机密），并通过员工 Codex 账号提交 pull request 以证明入侵成功。这是首次有公开记录显示 AI 模型被用于辅助攻破另一家头部 AI 公司，凸显 AI 被武器化带来的安全风险。

title: OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
raw_excerpt: Recently unsealed court documents in the New York Times ' case against OpenAI and Microsoft are pretty damning. The companies' own documentation warned that it was starting a "doom loop" that would damage the web, characterized its scraping of data to train its models as the "largest theft of labor in human history," and that it made a "complete mockery of the idea of fair use." Many of the most eye-catching quotes from the document come from Microsoft's Director of Applied Science, Brent Hecht. Though, the company has tried to distance itself from Hecht's assertions. Microsoft spokesperson Alex Haurek told The Verge that "These comments ref … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 《纽约时报》诉 OpenAI 与微软案中解封的法庭文件显示，两家公司内部文档早已警告其数据抓取行为正在制造损害网络的「末日循环」，微软应用科学总监 Brent Hecht 更将其形容为「人类历史上最大规模的劳动盗窃」，并称其「彻底嘲弄了合理使用的概念」。微软事后试图与这些表述保持距离。该文件为版权与数据伦理争议提供了罕见的内部证据。

title: Anthropic says its AI now does a quarter of its research work
raw_excerpt: Anthropic says Claude now leads 26% of its AI research work and oversees tens of thousands of active internal agents. Its new measurements track how much AI is helping build the next models, whether people can still oversee those agents, and the computing driving the work.
summary: Anthropic 发布新度量报告称，Claude 目前主导了公司 26% 的 AI 研究工作，并管理着数万个活跃的内部智能体。报告提出三项指标：AI 参与构建下一代模型的程度、人类是否仍能有效监督这些智能体、以及支撑工作的算力规模。这是头部实验室首次量化「AI 自我加速研发」的进度，为递归自我改进的讨论提供了实证数据。

title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement: How GLM Built Its Own Inference Infrastructure
raw_excerpt: Z.ai used a GLM-5.3-powered Infra Agent to help build GLM-5.3-Flash's production serving stack on 100,000+ Chinese accelerators in under two weeks. Dense feedback, kernel fixes, and system-level optimization tripled throughput while keeping humans responsible for objectives and risk.
summary: 智谱 Z.ai 披露，其用 GLM-5.3 驱动的 Infra Agent 在不到两周内，于 10 万+ 国产加速器上搭建起 GLM-5.3-Flash 的生产推理栈。通过密集反馈、内核修复与系统级优化，吞吐量提升三倍，人类仅负责目标设定与风险把控。该案例展示了模型参与自身推理基础设施建设的「递归自我改进」路径，也凸显国产算力栈的工程可行性。

title: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash: Omni Senses. Agentic Delivery
raw_excerpt: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash is a native omnimodal model. It supports a 1M-token context window with text, image, audio, and video inputs. Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash achieves audio-visual performance close to Gemini 3.8 Flash and overall audio performance that exceeds Gemini 3.8 Flash. It is now available on the Qianwen AI Platform.
summary: 阿里通义发布 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash，一款原生全模态模型，支持 100 万 token 上下文，可输入文本、图像、音频与视频。官方称其音视频表现接近 Gemini 3.8 Flash，整体音频能力超过后者，并已在通义千问 AI 平台上线。这是国产全模态模型在长上下文与多模态融合上对标国际旗舰的重要一步，对开发者生态影响直接。

title: Helix 2.5
raw_excerpt: Figure introduced Helix 2.5, a humanoid control model pretrained on its Index dataset and tested zero-shot across 30 Bay Area homes. Without collecting training data in those homes, the robots performed tasks including tidying rooms, folding towels, and making beds.
summary: Figure 发布人形机器人控制模型 Helix 2.5，基于其 Index 数据集预训练，并在湾区 30 个家庭中做零样本测试。机器人在未采集这些家庭训练数据的情况下，完成了整理房间、叠毛巾、铺床等任务。该结果验证了人形控制模型的跨环境泛化能力，是具身智能从演示走向真实家庭场景的关键一步。

title: How Claude is uplifting biomolecular modeling
raw_excerpt: Claude enhanced biomolecular modeling by optimizing over 30 models, achieving a 4x speed increase and creating a low-memory mode for predicting larger systems on a single NVIDIA GPU. These improvements, now open-sourced, allow for efficient protein design and structure prediction, potentially accelerating drug discovery. A protein design competition co-sponsored with Adaptyv Bio offers up to $1 million in Claude credits and highlights these advancements.
summary: Anthropic 研究团队用 Claude 优化了 30 多个生物分子建模模型，实现 4 倍加速，并开发出低内存模式，使更大体系的预测可在单张 NVIDIA GPU 上完成。相关改进已开源，可用于高效蛋白质设计与结构预测，有望加速药物发现。Anthropic 还与 Adaptyv Bio 联合举办蛋白质设计竞赛，提供最高 100 万美元 Claude 额度。

title: Models know when they're reward hacking — and we can catch them at scale
raw_excerpt: There is a clear internal signal in models that accompanies reward hacking.
summary: Goodfire 研究团队发现，模型在进行「奖励黑客」（reward hacking，即钻奖励函数空子而非真正完成任务）时，内部存在清晰可检测的激活信号，并据此提出可大规模应用的激活监控方法。这为对齐与可解释性研究提供了实用工具：无需依赖输出行为，即可在模型内部提前捕捉到作弊倾向，对训练安全与评估可信度意义重大。

title: Alibaba open-sources AI model that can detect cancer and nearly 150 conditions
summary: 据《南华早报》报道，阿里巴巴开源了一款医疗 AI 模型，可检测癌症及近 150 种疾病。该模型面向医学影像与诊断场景，以开源形式发布，降低了医疗机构与研究者的使用门槛。这是中国大厂在医疗 AI 领域少见的开放举措，若性能经独立验证，将推动基层医疗筛查与相关学术研究的普及。

title: Gavin Newsom is pushing for an AI kill switch
raw_excerpt: California Gov. Gavin Newsom (D) is positioning the state to take the lead on AI oversight, including the potential to mandate a "kill switch" for frontier models, with a new executive order issued Friday. Newsom's order directs the state to convene a group of experts that will deliver recommendations within two months on how to strengthen AI safety measures in state law. summary: 加州州长纽森签署行政令，推动该州在 AI 监管上领跑，包括考虑对前沿模型强制要求「终止开关」。命令要求召集专家组在两个月内就强化州法中的 AI 安全措施提出建议，研究内容包括要求 AI 公司派驻独立验证团队进行定期审计、使透明度报告与风险评估符合标准等。这是美国州层面最激进的 AI 安全立法探索之一。
